translations.web: Under the expanse, their wings were straight, one toward the other. Each one had two which covered on this side, and each one had two which covered their bodies on that side.
translations.bsb: And under the expanse, their wings stretched out toward one another. Each one also had two wings covering its body.
translations.kjv: And under the firmament were their wings straight, the one toward the other: every one had two, which covered on this side, and every one had two, which covered on that side, their bodies.
